description: [Daba Finance] Dr. Edoh Kossi Aménounvé, Chief Executive Officer of the Regional Stock Exchange (BRVM), received the "Outstanding Contribution to Financial Services in Africa" award. It specifically recognizes his leadership at the helm of the regional financial market of the West African Economic and Monetary Union (UEMOA).
